summary: Design agent completed Low-Level Design for FR-BRICK-002 (Issue #10) — Implement brick stacking with correct vertical snap-to-top-surface positioning. LLD covers: 3D occupancy map upgrade (StudKey3D, getTopLayerAt), placementEngine.resolveStackingPosition() using BVH raycast top-face detection, stacking Y formula (resolvedY = hitSurfaceY + halfHeight), GhostBrick.tsx new component, sceneStore ghostPosition state, useBrickPlacement stacking integration, 4 Mermaid sequence diagrams (happy path, side-face guard, collision guard, 4-brick stack), error handling matrix (7 scenarios), security considerations (5 items), performance strategy (BVH + O(1) map), test case mapping (T-BE-BRICK-002-01 through T-E2E-BRICK-002-01 with 4 unit test scenarios). Draft PR is open on branch feature/10-fr-brick-002-design awaiting Gate 6a human design review. Area determined as frontend (pure client-side SPA, React/Three.js/Zustand/Vitest toolchain). Depends on FR-BRICK-001 (Issue #12) and FR-SCENE-003 (Issue #9).

human_review_required: [HIGH] Gate 6a Design Review — Draft PR must be reviewed and approved by a human before implementation begins. The LLD defines the resolveStackingPosition() algorithm, 3D occupancy map upgrade, and stacking Y formula.
[HIGH] OQ-1: Confirm exact STUD_SPACING, PLATE_HEIGHT, BRICK_HEIGHT values from FR-BRICK-001 LLD — all Y-position calculations depend on these constants.
[HIGH] OQ-2: Confirm FR-BRICK-001 exposes BrickMesh with userData.isBrick=true and userData.brickInstance — useBrickPlacement raycast filter depends on this convention.
[HIGH] OQ-3: Confirm whether @react-three/drei BVH geometry is already integrated in FR-SCENE-003 or FR-BRICK-001 — if not, FR-BRICK-002 must add BVH setup.
[MEDIUM] OQ-4: Confirm ghost brick behaviour on collision — red ghost (better UX) vs disappear (current LLD). Red ghost requires validatePlacement on every pointer move.
[LOW] OQ-5: Confirm crypto.randomUUID() availability in target browser baseline.
